title: Autoformat commit identity: take author from workflow event, hardcode bot ID
answers: how does the autoformat workflow pick the git author for its commit
autoformat commit shows wrong author or bot email
why is mlflow-app[bot] ID hardcoded in autoformat workflow
change who gets credited for autoformatted commits
body:
Symptom: Commits pushed by the autoformat bot are attributed to the wrong user, or the bot's noreply email/ID is wrong.
Invariant: The 'Configure git' step in autoformat.yml sets user.name and user.email from github.event.issue.user (login, id, type), not from gh CLI or API lookups.
Bot case: when type is 'Bot', LOGIN is forced to 'mlflow-app[bot]' and ID is the hardcoded 191841109. Do not replace this with a runtime users/<login> API call.
Email format: git user.email must stay '${ID}+${LOGIN}@users.noreply.github.com' so GitHub links the commit to the right account.
Breaks if: the ID or the email format is changed independently, or the step reintroduces gh pr view/gh api, which adds token dependence and drifts from the event payload.
applies: Only .github/workflows/autoformat.yml, the 'Configure git' step. Other workflows that set commit identity are not covered by this note.
says: Commits created by the code formatting bot show the wrong author profile on GitHub.
The automated cleanup bot is crediting the wrong person on pull requests.
Automated style fixes show an incorrect bot email address and broken profile link.
Ensure automated formatting changes link cleanly to the official bot account.
Pull request formatting updates are attributed to the wrong team member.
search: In .github/workflows/autoformat.yml, the 'Configure git' step must set user.name and user.email directly from github.event.issue.user (login, id, type), hardcoding LOGIN to mlflow-app[bot] and ID to 191841109 when type is Bot. The email format must remain '${ID}+${LOGIN}@users.noreply.github.com' rather than using runtime users/<login> API calls or gh CLI lookups. This guidance applies strictly to the 'Configure git' step in .github/workflows/autoformat.yml and covers no other workflows.
